close_reason: Updated reg! macro in jmap-contacts-server to use ClosureHandlerWithCtx; clippy clean
description:
Update register_contacts_handlers to forward CallerCtx using ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B, C> (from JMAP-exue.1).

All ContactCard/* and AddressBook/* handler closures receive ctx: C. This is particularly important for contacts servers that need to enforce per-user visibility of address books.

Acceptance criteria:
- register_contacts_handlers closures receive CallerCtx
- cargo test -p jmap-contacts-server exits 0
- Clippy clean

Depends on JMAP-exue.1.
title: jmap-contacts-server: Forward CallerCtx in register_contacts_handlers
